notes.llm_in_signal_path: V10.1 signal path is a fixed JSON policy plus a deterministic Python engine (action_engine_v101.py); no LLM scores, ranks, selects, or sizes any shadow position.
notes.named_factor_semantics_visible_to_llm: Honest true: the research/design phase used public factor names and LLM-assisted development. This is exactly the V84 failure mode; it blocks the capital tier until mitigated by blind IDs, a custodian, and holdouts.
notes.model_blind_signal_ids_used: Tickers are named in forecasts. Acceptable for shadow scoring while llm_in_signal_path is false; insufficient for capital.
notes.independent_data_custodian_used: Single-operator infrastructure. Required before any capital tier pass.
notes.low_contamination_asset_holdout: Not yet established. Required before any capital tier pass.
notes.assumed_max_model_training_cutoff: Conservative bound: frontier model cutoffs extend into late 2025. Shadow outcomes mature 2026-10-27 or later, i.e. strictly after this bound.
